misconceptions.misconception: Believing high leverage creates free profits without downside risk.
misconceptions.authorRebuttal: Physical settlement allows the protection buyer to deliver any eligible senior unsecured bond from the reference entity, enabling them to exploit cheapest-to-deliver bond optionality ([fact-03]).

misconceptions.misconception: Believing high leverage creates free profits without downside risk.
misconceptions.authorRebuttal: The Gaussian copula failed completely during the 2007-2008 crisis because it assumed zero tail dependence, masking catastrophic contagion and cascading defaults across CDO tranches ([fact-10]).

coreTakeaways: Credit Default Swaps (CDS) provide bilateral insurance against ISDA credit events, settling via physical delivery or cash auctions ([fact-01], [fact-02], [fact-03]).
Hazard rates and fair CDS spreads link corporate bond spreads and recovery rates to default probabilities ([fact-04], [fact-05], [fact-06]).

Synthetic CDOs, standardized CDX/iTraxx indices, and the Gaussian copula highlight both the power and tail-risk vulnerability of modern credit derivatives, reinforced by post-2008 central clearing regulations ([fact-08], [fact-09], [fact-10], [fact-11]).
